files.scope: 17字段固定序二进制签名帧的不可变构造、解析、长度/ASCII/U63/严格UTF8与原始字节保真；不含JSON外包络、签名验证或准入
files.inputOutput: 输入全部17字段或<=35000B帧；输出不可变帧及类型受限的复制访问；所有格式错误以无私有内容的异常拒绝
files.dependencies: Java8公开标准库，API30支持的ByteBuffer/CharsetDecoder；无Android/UI/数据库/新依赖
notClaimed: SPKI/DER验签、密钥身份/权限/挑战/replay/持久化并发
files.integrationGate: 解析成功只能进入后续验证；在ControlDecoder/ChallengeStore/Dispatcher及全部权限闸门完成前，不挂公开入口、不执行动作

files.scope: canonical bounded Base64url/SHA256, exact uncompressed P256 SPKI+point/curve check and strict positive DER scalars; not verifier/admission/private-key storage
files.inputOutput: <=65536-byte snapshots with per-field limits; canonical EC public key or raw digest/validated DER syntax; no private input values in errors
files.dependencies: Java8 Base64/BigInteger/EC KeyFactory/SHA256; no generated keys or new library
notClaimed: strict JSON/atomic replay and domain execution
files.integrationGate: callers must enforce actual key identity/policy, ECDSA verification and remaining proof admission; no public entrypoints enabled
